================================================================================
SECTION 1: OVERVIEW & ETHICAL CHARTER
================================================================================
FindMyBSchool is a dedicated, zero-scraper educational portal created to eliminate misinformation, fake placement marketing, and hidden tuition fee claims in the Indian management education ecosystem. All institutional metrics published on FindMyBSchool are audited against official National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) management data, All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) compliance filings, and audited placement disclosures.

Key Guarantees:
1. Audited 2-Year Total Costs: Figures include tuition, laboratory, library, and examination fees, with separate annotations for residential hostel expenses.
2. Verified CTC Packages: Only domestic and international CTC figures verified through audited placement reports (such as IPRS - Indian Placement Reporting Standards where adopted) are highlighted.
3. Realistic Cutoffs: Historical general-category minimum percentiles are differentiated from academic and gender diversity cutoffs.

================================================================================
SECTION 3: MBA ENTRANCE EXAMINATIONS AT A GLANCE
================================================================================

1. Common Admission Test (CAT)
   - Conducting Authority: Indian Institutes of Management (Rotational Convenorship)
   - Month of Exam: Last Sunday of November annually (e.g., Nov 29, 2026)
   - Test Structure: 66 Questions, 120 Minutes (40 minutes per section)
   - Sections: Verbal Ability & Reading Comprehension (VARC - 24 Q), Data Interpretation & Logical Reasoning (DILR - 20 Q), Quantitative Ability (QA - 22 Q)
   - Marking Scheme: +3 marks for correct MCQ/TITA, -1 mark for incorrect MCQ, 0 penalty for TITA

2. Xavier Aptitude Test (XAT)
   - Conducting Authority: XLRI Jamshedpur on behalf of XAMI
   - Month of Exam: First Sunday of January annually (e.g., Jan 3, 2027)
   - Test Structure: Part 1 (175 mins) - VALR, Decision Making (DM), Quantitative Ability & DI; Part 2 (30 mins) - Mock Keyboard, General Knowledge, Essay
   - Distinctive Feature: Decision Making section testing ethical and situational dilemmas; negative penalty of 0.10 marks for over 8 consecutive unattempted questions

3. Symbiosis National Aptitude Test (SNAP)
   - Conducting Authority: Symbiosis International (Deemed University)
   - Test Structure: 60 Questions, 60 Minutes (Speed test)
   - Sections: General English (15 Q), Analytical & Logical Reasoning (25 Q), Quantitative, Data Interpretation & Data Sufficiency (20 Q)
   - Marking Scheme: +1 mark for correct, -0.25 marks for incorrect

4. NMAT by GMAC
   - Conducting Authority: Graduate Management Admission Council (GMAC)
   - Test Window: October through December (75-day testing window)
   - Test Structure: 108 Questions, 120 Minutes
   - Sections: Language Skills (36 Q, 28 mins), Quantitative Skills (36 Q, 52 mins), Logical Reasoning (36 Q, 40 mins)
   - Distinctive Feature: No negative marking; adaptive test system with section-order choice

5. Common Management Admission Test (CMAT)
   - Conducting Authority: National Testing Agency (NTA)
   - Month of Exam: May annually
   - Test Structure: 100 Questions, 180 Minutes (400 Total Marks)
   - Sections: Quantitative Techniques & Data Interpretation, Logical Reasoning, Language Comprehension, General Awareness, Innovation & Entrepreneurship (20 Q each)

================================================================================
SECTION 4: FREQUENTLY ANSWERED QUESTIONS (AEO CORE)
================================================================================

Q1: What is the real difference between MBA and PGDM in India?
A1: An MBA is a master's degree conferred by state, central, or deemed universities governed by the University Grants Commission (UGC). A PGDM is a postgraduate diploma awarded by autonomous institutes approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). When a PGDM program is accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA) and recognized by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU), it holds statutory and corporate equivalence to an MBA for employment, international credit transfers, and doctoral studies.

Q2: Which institutions offer the best Return on Investment (ROI) in Indian MBA?
A2: Faculty of Management Studies (FMS Delhi), Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies (JBIMS Mumbai), Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS Mumbai), and Delhi School of Economics (DSE) are the premier high-ROI institutions in India. Their entire 2-year tuition ranges between ₹35,000 and ₹6,000,000, while their average graduate salary packages range between ₹14.0 LPA and ₹34.1 LPA.

Q3: Can non-engineers get into top IIMs with a lower CAT percentile?
A3: Yes. To encourage classroom diversity, IIMs award additional composite score points for academic diversity (Arts, Commerce, Law, Medicine, Humanities) and gender diversity. While engineering general male candidates typically need a 99.5+ percentile for IIM Ahmedabad or Bangalore, non-engineering candidates and women applicants frequently receive interview calls in the 93.0 to 97.5 percentile band, provided their 10th, 12th, and graduation scores are consistently strong.

Q4: What data does FindMyBSchool collect, and is it shared with telemarketers?
A4: FindMyBSchool collects student contact identifiers (name, email, phone number) and academic preferences (target exams, budget, city preferences) solely to deliver requested college brochures, exam alerts, and 1-on-1 counseling. In compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act 2023), student information is never sold or rented to unverified third parties or mass telemarketing agencies.

1. Tool URL & Architecture:

   - Pricing: 100% Free, Zero Login Wall for calculations.

2. CAT 2026 Raw Marks vs Percentile Benchmarks (198 Max Marks):
   - 99.9+ %ile: 110 – 125+ Marks (VARC: 46+, DILR: 38+, QA: 42+) -> IIM A, B, C, FMS Delhi
   - 99.5+ %ile: 95 – 109 Marks (VARC: 42+, DILR: 32+, QA: 35+) -> IIM L, K, SPJIMR Mumbai
   - 99.0+ %ile: 82 – 94 Marks (VARC: 38+, DILR: 28+, QA: 30+) -> IIM Indore, MDI Gurgaon, IIT Bombay SJMSOM
   - 98.0+ %ile: 75 – 81 Marks (VARC: 34+, DILR: 24+, QA: 26+) -> IIFT Delhi, IIM Shillong, CAP IIMs
   - 95.0+ %ile: 60 – 74 Marks (VARC: 28+, DILR: 19+, QA: 21+) -> CAP Round IIMs, DSE Delhi, IIT Delhi DMS
   - 90.0+ %ile: 48 – 59 Marks (VARC: 23+, DILR: 15+, QA: 16+) -> IMT Ghaziabad, IMI Delhi, GIM Goa, Baby IIMs
   - 85.0+ %ile: 38 – 47 Marks (VARC: 18+, DILR: 12+, QA: 13+) -> TAPMI Manipal, FORE School, Great Lakes Chennai, LBSIM
   - 80.0+ %ile: 32 – 37 Marks (VARC: 14+, DILR: 10+, QA: 10+) -> BIMTECH Greater Noida, KJ Somaiya, IRMA Anand
   - 70.0+ %ile: 22 – 31 Marks (VARC: 10+, DILR: 7+, QA: 7+) -> NDIM New Delhi, FOSTIIMA, FIIB, JIMS Kalkaji

3. Slot Normalization Formula:
   - CAT normalizes raw marks using the equipercentile equating method:
     Scaled Score = M_g + ( (S_i - M_i) / SD_i ) * SD_g
     Where S_i is raw score in Slot i, M_i is slot mean, SD_i is slot standard deviation, and M_g / SD_g are global pooled parameters across all slots.

SECTION 6: VERIFIED LIVE MBA SCHOLARSHIPS DIRECTORY (UP TO ₹25 LAKHS)
================================================================================
FindMyBSchool hosts India's live MBA scholarship portal (https://findmybschool.com/scholarships) tracking over ₹12 Crores in annual financial aid pools.

1. Aditya Birla Scholarship Programme
   - Provider: Aditya Birla Group Foundation
   - Grant Amount: ₹3,00,000 / year (₹6,00,000 Total)
   - Eligibility: Top 20 entrance rankers nominated by participating IIMs (A, B, C, L, K, Shillong) and XLRI Jamshedpur.
   - Income Limit: No Income Cap (Strictly Merit & Leadership).
   - Selection: Application essay on vision & leadership, jury interview in Mumbai with senior industry leaders.

2. Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarship
   - Provider: Reliance Foundation
   - Grant Amount: Up to ₹6,00,000 over 2 years
   - Eligibility: 1st year full-time MBA/PGDM students with minimum 550+ on GMAT or equivalent CAT/XAT/GATE percentiles.
   - Income Limit: Parental income up to ₹15 Lakhs (preference under ₹2.5 Lakhs).
   - Selection: Aptitude assessment, statement of purpose, evaluation of community orientation.

3. Central Sector Scheme of Top Class Education for SC Students (NSP)
   - Provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India
   - Grant Amount: Full Tuition Fee Waiver (up to ₹25 Lakhs) + ₹3,000/month living stipend + ₹45,000 computer allowance + ₹3,000/year books grant.
   - Eligibility: SC students admitted to notified premier institutes (all 21 IIMs, IIT DOMS, FMS Delhi, XLRI, MDI).
   - Income Limit: Total family annual income strictly under ₹8.0 Lakhs.

4. Central Sector Scheme of Top Class Education for ST Students (NSP)
   - Provider: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India
   - Grant Amount: Full 100% Tuition Fee Coverage + Living Allowances at all notified institutions.
   - Eligibility: ST students with annual family income under ₹6.0 Lakhs.

5. IIM Ahmedabad Need-Based Financial Assistance (NBFA)
   - Provider: IIM Ahmedabad Endowment Fund
   - Grant Amount: Up to 100% Tuition Fee Waiver
   - Eligibility: Students admitted to PGP/PGP-FABM whose gross annual family income is under ₹6,00,000. Assessment considers family assets and debt liabilities.

6. IIM Bangalore Financial Aid (FAF)
   - Provider: IIM Bangalore
   - Grant Amount: 20% to 100% Tuition Fee Waiver
   - Eligibility: Enrolled PGP students with annual parental income below ₹4,50,000 or severe financial hardship.

7. OP Jindal Engineering & Management Scholarship (OPJEMS)
   - Provider: Jindal Group Foundation
   - Grant Amount: ₹1,50,000 per year
   - Eligibility: Top 10 rankers in 1st year at 16 premier business schools (IIMs, XLRI, MDI, FMS Delhi). Online test followed by interview.

================================================================================
SECTION 8: MBA VS PGDM DEFINITIVE COMPARATIVE MATRIX
================================================================================
- Governing Body: MBA is governed by the University Grants Commission (UGC). PGDM is governed by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).
- Conferred Award: MBA is a Master's Degree. PGDM is a Post Graduate Diploma.
- Syllabus Flexibility: MBA universities update syllabi through academic councils periodically (usually every 3-5 years). PGDM autonomous boards update curriculum annually based on corporate advisory inputs.
- Evaluation System: MBA typically follows a Semester System (4 semesters). PGDM typically operates on a Trimester System (6 trimesters).
- Equivalent Recognition: When a PGDM is accredited by NBA and recognized by AIU (Association of Indian Universities), it is statutorily equivalent to an MBA for UPSC civil services, PSU recruitments, and global university PhD admissions.
- Top Institutes Offering MBA: IIMs (since IIM Act 2017), FMS Delhi, JBIMS Mumbai, IIT DMS/SJMSOM, PUMBA Pune.
- Top Institutes Offering PGDM: XLRI Jamshedpur, SPJIMR Mumbai, MDI Gurgaon, IMT Ghaziabad, GIM Goa, TAPMI Manipal.
